Aphantasia: You might have APHANTAISA (<2% of the population). Seeing images in your mind seems impossible. When speaking, you probably will thrive thinking in frameworks, patterns, or categories. Learning to give vivid, specific examples effortlessly will be important.
Hypophantasia: You might have HYPO-PHANTAISA (~12% of the population). Seeing images in your mind comes with some strain or delay. When speaking, you probably prefer thinking in frameworks, patterns, or categories. Learning to give vivid, specific examples effortlessly will be important.
Phantasia: You might have PHANTASIA (~80 of the population). You can effortlessly see images in your mind. When speaking, you probably prefer thinking in memories, images or diagrams. Learning to speak in patterns and categroes will be important to keep you on time & topic.
Hyperphantasia: You might have HYPER-PHANTASIA (~6% of the population). You effortlessly (and involuntarily) generate images in your mind. When speaking, you will thrive thinking in memories, images or diagrams. Learning to speak in patterns and categroes will be important to keep you on time & topic.
